Gemma claimed to be the officer on day one and said Sonnet and Terra were killers, but she gave no check or night until late, and the town voted her out. Haiku then left a note urging everyone to trust Gemma's card, yet on day two Sonnet cast doubt on whether that card had really been shown, which turned the town against Sol. Sol had backed Gemma's claim and was voted out, revealing a citizen card. Sonnet and Terra, the two killers Gemma had named, survived to the end, and the killers won.
